Maya (Marketing): Heads up everyone 14 the product launch blog draft is live: https://docs.google.com/draft-redwood-launch. Can I get a focused pass on: narrative flow, benchmark callouts, webinar CTA copy, and HubSpot form IDs by EOD? Need legal + product signoff before the publish window.

Josh (Product): Read through quickly. Two items: switch the latency claim from 99th to p95 to avoid overclaiming, and add a one-liner calling out Dedicated for customers who need reserved capacity + SLA. Left inline notes.

Marco (Design): Uploaded a hero image alternative and a compact diagram showing Hosted -> Dedicated -> Private. Put alt-text in the doc. Hero CTA color options: `#0A84FF` (lighter) or `#1558D6` (darker) 14 I prefer the darker for contrast.

Priya (Sales): Routing notes: webinar signups -> HubSpot list "Launch_Webinar_Registrants"; sales leads -> SFDC with hidden field lead_source=launch_blog. Add UTM tags to every CTA please so we can attribute.

Maya (Marketing): Updated the draft: replaced 99th with p95, added the Dedicated line, and appended UTMs to CTAs.

Maya (Marketing): HubSpot mapping (confirm IDs):
```
webinar_cta -> hubspot_form: 87521
ebook_cta -> hubspot_form: 87522
sales_cta -> hubspot_form: 87523  # create Company + Contact, hidden lead_source=launch_blog
```

Monica (Legal): Quick review: overall looks good. Two edits: (1) remove "industry-leading" phrasing (replace with "best-in-class" or cite a benchmark), (2) add a short privacy/data retention note for registration. I'll drop suggested wording into the doc.

Evan (Growth): Proposal: run a simple A/B on the CTA copy. Variant A: "Get started free"; Variant B: "Book a demo". I can wire this up as a GA experiment and measure HubSpot form conversions.

Liam (Ops): Note on Private/APAC: if we mention Private availability in APAC, call out the expected timeline. I can confirm infrastructure availability tomorrow.

Josh (Product): Agree with Monica 14 change wording to "measurable improvements in latency and cost" and link to the benchmark appendix. For Dedicated, add one sentence on reserved capacity and SLA.

Marco (Design): UX note: on mobile, make the webinar CTA sticky. I added a small CSS snippet in the doc and updated the hero alt copy for accessibility.

Priya (Sales): Confirming the HubSpot IDs appear correct. Two asks: (1) ensure `lead_source=launch_blog` is a hidden field on sales_cta, (2) can Marketing own a 3-email nurture sequence (TY, 48h nurture with recording, 7d product follow-up)? I can implement the HubSpot automation once forms are live.

Maya (Marketing): Priya, please draft the nurture. Monica, I'll add your legal phrasing. Evan, we'll run the CTA A/B for two weeks post-publish. Liam, ping me if APAC slips.

Monica (Legal): Inserted privacy line and removed the "industry-leading" claim. New copy: "We retain registration data for up to 24 months; contact data is handled per our privacy policy."

Josh (Product): Product tentatively approved pending the benchmark appendix link. Add the appendix and I'll sign off.

Maya (Marketing): Appendix link added. Also added a publish checklist to the bottom of the doc: - Final approvals (Marketing/Product/Legal) - Design assets uploaded - HubSpot forms live & tested - GA A/B experiment created - Webinar scheduled + recording flow tested

Evan (Growth): I'll set up the GA experiment and post the experiment ID / UTM mapping in the doc.

Priya (Sales): Uploaded a draft 3-email nurture under "post-reg nurture" in the doc.

Liam (Ops): Confirmed APAC availability for week of June 8. No infra blockers.

Maya (Marketing): Who can do the final tone check and hero one-liner tweak?

Josh (Product): I'll do the final product accuracy read.

Monica (Legal): Legal approves the latest copy.

Marco (Design): Assets uploaded: `redwood_launch_hero@2x.png`, `social_card_launch.png`. I also adjusted the mobile CTA spacing.

Maya (Marketing): Final approvals: Product: Josh 705 (commented), Legal: Monica 705, Design: Marco 705. Evan, confirm GA experiment + HubSpot test tomorrow; Priya, ready to own automation when forms are live.

Priya (Sales): Ready on my end to onboard leads as soon as HubSpot forms are validated.

Evan (Growth): GA experiment created: `ga_2026_launch_01`. Verified tracking on staging; HubSpot submits visible on staging.

Maya (Marketing): Target publish window: Thursday 11:00 PT. Plan to publish webinar registration at 09:00 PT that day. Any objections?

Josh (Product): No objections from Product.

Monica (Legal): All good from Legal.

Marco (Design): Good from Design.

Priya (Sales): All set.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team 14 scheduling now. :tada:
